description: Build the original, evidence-labelled five-stop Signal Trail on top of FEAT-001's semantic shell. It is a single coherent portfolio story: native scrolling and hash links drive a lightweight 2.5D editorial field notebook, while configuration keeps facts, source status, proposed work, and public-safe omissions explicit.
steps: Create src/signal-run/content/trail.js as the only source of trail data: public GitHub/Devpost/code/live links, source labels, five stop records, generic illustrative alert fragments, the 14-day proposed Bangalore growth experiment, the $3,000 first-person Field Kit answer, itemized budget, and consent/contact checklist. Use the source-verification document exactly: Nexus figures are diagnostic evaluation figures; A.S.T.R.A. stays defensive and sandbox-only; Vayu cites baselines and the stale-checkpoint failure; VRI/Wordwatch are concise resume-backed confidential-safe summaries; the growth experiment is clearly not run.

Create SignalGlyph.jsx with original inline SVG runner/signal/wave layers; TrailMap.jsx with a five-anchor route and visible scroll/click/Tab/Enter guidance; TrailStop.jsx with semantic article/heading/evidence-label structure; ProofLinks.jsx with descriptive safe outbound links; and FieldKit.jsx with the final proposed experiment and $3,000 budget.

Replace the FEAT-001 placeholder main in src/signal-run/App.jsx with a hero, at-a-glance five-step route, five compact mapped articles in this exact order: Nexus Prime, A.S.T.R.A., Vayu, VRI + Wordwatch, One Breath, One Message. Give each article signal → decision or documented mistake → what changed → source/proposal structure. Include only approved source links, omit a Vayu live link, and keep public contact GitHub/Devpost only.

Create src/signal-run/signal-run.css with mobile-first CSS variables, system editorial typography, code-created paper/ink gradients, restrained layered depth, whitespace, touch-safe targets, highly visible focus, contrast/forced-colors support, and reduced-motion rules. Make the route legible as normal scrolling content in roughly 15 seconds without audio or clicking; do not use Canvas, WebGL, downloaded images, custom texture files, neon cyberpunk styling, free-roam mechanics, animation loops, or dashboard framing.
acceptance_criteria: Visitors can use normal scroll, visible hash links, click, and Tab/Enter to reach every one of the five semantic stop articles; browser hash history works without custom routing.
The opening begins exactly “I build things that have to be right after the demo.” and the page visibly describes its no-3D fallback instead of making it a hidden accessibility alternative.

Nexus displays 150 incidents, 90% top-1 diagnostic accuracy, 8.0% → 1.2% hallucinations, and 48.3 minutes → 6.1 seconds only as labelled evaluation/diagnosis evidence. A.S.T.R.A. never teaches offensive activity. Vayu labels both baselines and the plausible-output stale-model error. VRI/Wordwatch contain no confidential artefacts.

The final stop visibly labels the experiment proposed/not run and includes its audience, hypothesis, 14-day steps, repeat-activation north star, kill condition, consent-first methodology, $3,000 total, and transparent line items.
At 375 px and desktop width the hierarchy, focus state, source labels, original SVG/CSS composition, and reduced-motion static presentation remain readable with no canvas element.
verification: npm run dev, then inspect at 375 px and 1280 px: scroll/no-click read-through, all five anchors via click and Tab/Enter, source-link labels, browser hash back/forward, focus visibility, and reduced-motion/forced-colors presentation.
In the browser DOM inspector, confirm no canvas is rendered and the active bundle makes no Canvas/Three.js/PostHog/Sanity/microphone/speech-recognition import or request.
findings: Completed FEAT-002: created the configuration-driven five-stop Signal Trail, original inline SVG glyph, semantic route map/articles, safe proof links, proposed One Breath, One Message field kit, consent/contact checklist, and mobile-first editorial CSS. Claim-boundary review confirmed labelled Nexus diagnostic-evaluation figures, defensive sandbox-only A.S.T.R.A. wording, Vayu code-only/no-live status with its baseline and stale-output lesson, résumé-backed confidential-safe VRI/Wordwatch summaries, and a proposed/not-run growth test with no analytics or phone contact. Validation passed: npm ci completed with 154 packages and npm-reported 16 audit vulnerabilities; npm run lint passed with zero warnings/errors; npm run build passed with 35 transformed modules. Headless Chrome checks against npm run dev and the final npm run preview verified desktop and 375 px layouts, normal reading, direct hash links, all five pointer click plus Tab/Enter routes, browser back/forward, visible focus, reduced-motion and forced-colors presentation, no-JS summary, no canvas, no audio/autoplay, and no active Three.js/PostHog/Sanity/microphone/speech-recognition dependency or request. Voice Notes empty/loading/error states are FEAT-005 scope and were not introduced to keep this implementation limited to FEAT-002; this feature renders no media and requests no microphone. Local commit status: unavailable because the supplied archive has no .git metadata; Git was not initialized and nothing was pushed. Completion: FEAT-002 is ready for the next workflow step.
